description: Defines the 'language' entity field item class for Drupal, including property definitions, schema, default values, change handling, and options related to language entities.

classes.name: LanguageItem
classes.description: A Drupal field item class representing a language reference, with methods for property definitions, schema, default value application, change handling, and options generation.

methods.name: propertyDefinitions
methods.description: Defines the properties 'value' (language code) and 'language' (language object reference).

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Provides the database schema for the language item, with a varchar column for the language code.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the language item, handling both scalar and array inputs.

methods.name: applyDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value to the site's default language.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Ensures 'value' and 'language' properties stay synchronized when one changes.

methods.name: generateSampleValue
methods.description: Generates a sample language value, either via callback or randomly from available languages.

methods.name: getPossibleOptions
methods.description: Returns display names for all available languages.

methods.name: getSettableValues
methods.description: Returns settable language codes, same as getPossibleValues.

methods.name: getSettableOptions
methods.description: Returns settable language options, same as getPossibleOptions.
